instructions: Drain the mozzarella balls and pat them dry. Pick off 12 basil leaves.
Thread a cherry tomato onto a skewer, then a mozzarella ball.
Fold a basil leaf in half and thread it on. Add a second mozzarella ball and finish with another cherry tomato.
Repeat to make 12 skewers, and lay them in a single layer on a platter.
Drizzle the 2 tbsp balsamic glaze over the skewers and sprinkle with the 1/4 tsp salt.
Serve right away. To make them ahead, keep the skewers in the fridge for up to 4 hours and add the glaze and salt just before serving.
method_notes: Sweet Phi (the lead, 5.0 from 3 votes, visible rating, so no version has 20 ratings) threads tomato, mozzarella ball, folded basil, mozzarella ball and tomato onto a skewer, then drizzles balsamic reduction and salt. The Kitchen Magpie (no ratings) uses one tomato, one bocconcini and one basil leaf per toothpick and cooks its own reduction. This uses store-bought glaze to keep the effort small and makes 12 skewers for four.
